title: Delphi build artifacts are excluded from version control
rationale: Delphi emits DCU/DCP/EXE binaries and writes IDE state into __history/ and __recovery/. A noisy diff and a bloated repo are the first sign the ignore list missed a Delphi project; copying the template fixes it in one pass.
hint: Copy templates/delphi/.gitignore to the repo root or merge its sections into the existing .gitignore.

title: Delphi source line endings are normalized
rationale: Delphi is a Windows ecosystem; without a .gitattributes entry for its text files, .pas/.dpr/.dproj files land with mixed CRLF and LF depending on the developer's git autocrlf setting, and a small edit then shows as a thousand-line diff. INI-Korrektur hit exactly this on the XE5 to 13 move.
hint: Copy templates/delphi/.gitattributes (declares *.pas, *.dpr, *.dproj, *.cfg as CRLF text, DFM/BMP/RES as binary).

title: The project builds through an MSBuild .dproj file
rationale: The .dproj format (Delphi 2007 and later) is MSBuild XML. A pipeline, a conformance checker and a new developer can all build it from one well-known entry point; the older .dpr/.bpg flow needs the IDE and does not script.
hint: Open the .dpr in the Delphi IDE once; it writes the .dproj beside it. Older projects (.bpg) migrate through the IDE's Project > Add to Project Group.

title: The Delphi edition the project builds against is named
rationale: Delphi code often relies on units or syntax that moved between editions (System.UITypes, generics, inline vars). A line in CLAUDE.md or the README naming the edition (RAD Studio 13, XE5, ...) tells a new developer which installer to grab and a pipeline which image to use.
hint: Add a short line to CLAUDE.md or README.md, e.g. 'Builds with Delphi 13 (RAD Studio 13)'.

title: The build command is documented
rationale: A written MSBuild command (with the .dproj and configuration) is what lets a new developer or a CI agent build the project without opening the IDE. In INI-Korrektur the Delphi 13 upgrade worked because the command path was known; the alternative is a 72k-line codebase that only the person who last opened it can build.
hint: Add the exact build command to CLAUDE.md, e.g. 'MSBuild ini_korrektur1.dproj /p:config=Release /t:Build' plus the rsvars.bat call that puts the Delphi tools into PATH.
